LogEntries.Entry: A hauler set down near the <Alias=DungeonLocation> was jumped on her run. The raiders left her the ship and took the cargo, a crate of water filters somebody is waiting for.
Raiders jumped a hauler and took her cargo, a crate of water filters, to the <Alias=FinalLocation>. I need to get the filters back and finish her run to the <Alias=ThirdLocation>.
I took the crate of water filters back from the raiders' leader at the <Alias=FinalLocation>. Now I need to finish the run to the <Alias=ThirdLocation>.
I've got the Goods Package. It goes to <Alias=FinalLocation> on <Alias=targetPlanet>, whenever I'm heading that way.

A hauler was jumped on her run and lost a crate of water filters to raiders at the <Alias=FinalLocation>. I got them back and finished the run to the <Alias=ThirdLocation>, where they had been boiling every drop for a week.

Objectives.DisplayText: Talk to the hauler at the <Alias=DungeonLocation>
Recover the filter crate from the <Alias=FinalLocation>
Deliver the water filters to the <Alias=ThirdLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You're not one of them, are you? Then you can help, if you want to.
I'll get your cargo back.
Water filters, one crate. Somebody's waiting on them. Don't bring it back to me. Take it where it was going.
What happened?
More than I could argue with. Very polite until they weren't. They took the crate and left me the ship, which I suppose was kind of them.
Did you report it?
I did. Someone's going to look into it next month. The filters were due last week.
Describe the one in charge.
Did all the talking. Laughed at their own jokes. I won't miss them.
Easy. I've had enough visitors this week.
If you're selling, we're not buying. Unless it's filters.
Tell me you've got our filters. We've been boiling every drop for a week.
Your filters. The hauler sent them on.
She's all right? I'll have these in before I sleep. First glass I don't have to wait for, I'm raising it to her.
Boiling kills things. It won't take metals out.
No, I know. That's why we stopped asking what the taste was.
How bad has it been?
The old ones clogged. You can drink what comes out, if you don't look at it.
Is it just you here?
Enough of us. Every one of them has told me how to fix the pump.
I've been jumped. I'm fine, the ship's fine. The cargo isn't, and somebody's waiting on it.
